core_obligations: Use local standard etaleness and quasi-compactness to find finitely many elements generating the unit ideal over which the map is standard etale, and reduce to the product of the localisations (proof lines 40367-40372).

Solve the problem for the product by taking the product of the individual finite flat solutions and verify the three listed properties, including the local factoring through the given etale map (proof lines 40372-40396).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a finite cover on which the map is standard etale (proof lines 40366-40372).
Assemble the finite flat algebra and check the properties (proof lines 40372-40397).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a surjective etale map is dominated by a finite finitely presented flat map in the sense that the latter factors through the former after inverting one element at each prime (statement lines 40347-40364). The proof reduces to a finite cover on which the etale map is standard etale, solves the problem there, and assembles the solutions by taking a product, then verifies the factoring property prime by prime (proof lines 40366-40397). Reducing to a finite standard etale cover is the step that makes the global assembly finite. H2.
